frequency_question: How often do complex financial secondary sanction investigations successfully move from initial intelligence gathering to formal Treasury designation within a 12-month window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal Treasury actions designating major foreign financial institutions for sanctions under secondary sanctions authorities; excludes routine minor penalty settlements or informal warnings.

cases.name: Network of entities linked to Iranian petrochemicals (various banks)

provenance_note: 5 cases named, 8 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.6x)
coverage_note: 5 named historical clear precedents; estimated 8 total major formal foreign bank secondary sanction processes initiated.
known_gaps: Classified or unpublicized preliminary investigative steps that did not result in public designation are difficult to fully enumerate.
skeleton: Skeleton multiplier not used directly; case-based historical enumeration of major secondary financial institution designations.
multiplier: 5 historical major foreign bank secondary sanction actions meeting the strict procedural criteria divided by estimated total initiated complex investigations (approx 8)
validity_reason: Statutory timelines and inter-agency review processes for OFAC designations remain relatively stable across administrations.
